biography:
Merging my 25 years of Creative Solutioning, Engineering, Construction and Cost Management to enable Data Center Development in numerous US and International markets . My current focus is to utilize my wealth of relationships and experiences to enable QTS to deliver our Federal, Hyperscale and Hybrid Solutions. I have also spent the majority of my energies building organizations and being a forward thinking change agent transforming organizations processes and designs to adapt to changing technologies and keep them at the forefront of industry.

My best and highest skill would be in building teams that can deliver the above. One person can do very little but a highly focused and led team can move mountains and do it the right way. Creating these teams and coaching them to success is my greatest accomplishment.

Degreed Mechanical Engineer, Texas A&M University, College St. Texas

Specific Background in leading groups of Design and Construction Professionals, doing Mission Critical and other MEP Intensive Projects.

Specialties: 
1. Leadership and Communication Skills across Broad Organizations.
2. Strong Managerial and Team Building Skills for Both Internal and External Teams
3. Understanding and Building Relationships with Clients and Ensuring Successful Engagements
4. Execution Skills : EPC of Data Centers, Millions of square feet and over a Gigawatt deployed.
5. Deep Knowledge areas (SME): Engineering, Architecture, Construction, Cost Accuracy, Contracts
6. Efficiency in Design to Pursue Low PUE Facilities
7. 25 years of Relationships in Construction and Design the majority in Mission Critical
8. Operations Understanding and Design for Success
9. ESG Initiatives and Employing them Successfully at Scale
